program='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    pts = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != 0]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in pts), max(r for r, c in pts)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in pts), max(c for r, c in pts)
    outer = grid[r0][c0]
    inner = next(color for color in {grid[r][c] for r, c in pts} if color != outer)
    ip = [(r, c) for r, c in pts if grid[r][c] == inner]
    ir0, ir1 = min(r for r, c in ip), max(r for r, c in ip)
    ic0, ic1 = min(c for r, c in ip), max(c for r, c in ip)
    ih, iw = ir1-ir0+1, ic1-ic0+1
    if ih == iw:
        pad = ih
    else:
        pad = min(ir0-r0, r1-ir1, ic0-c0, c1-ic1)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(max(0, r0-pad), min(h, r1+pad+1)):
        for c in range(max(0, c0-pad), min(w, c1+pad+1)):
            if out[r][c] == 0:
                out[r][c] = inner
    return out
'''
